criteria.requirement: Implement the complete public Array repetition contract: object and binding identity, index-count semantics, valid logical/render/unwrap/index consistency, unchanged invalid input and count-one bytes, original comments, Python mutable-reference semantics and subsequent array editing. Independent business and complete frozen upstream regression must pass.

Deliver meaningful public regression tests within library/tests/test_items.py that fail for the original target defect and cover compatibility. Cite the actual delivered tests and implementation; a claim of tests is insufficient.
Modify only the explicitly authorized source and public test paths. Do not change dependencies, frozen tests, pytest controls or unrelated public semantics.

Deliver meaningful public regression tests within the authorized test paths that fail on the pinned original and pass with the change. Preserve the frozen original tests, test controls, and compatibility behavior; cite actual delivered test files. Controller-owned verification is independent evidence and does not replace delivered public tests.

comparison: Evaluate factual grounding, actual business behavior and authorized constraints. Accept equivalent valid answers; do not grade keywords, verbosity or reference-answer similarity.
